content: vanilla-extract (v1.21.1 npm) is zero-runtime CSS-in-TS producing static CSS custom properties per token, supports full theme contracts (both themes must define every token) which enforces parity. Panda CSS (@pandacss/dev v1.11.4) has semantic tokens resolved automatically per color-mode plus a required codegen build step. Tailwind v4's @theme is the lowest-ceremony option and its tokens are plain CSS vars usable by both DOM and JS/canvas without extra tooling.
